capabilities.name: Versioned discovery document format
capabilities.description: JSON Schema and example define the discovery document contract.
limitations: Scaffolding only; downstream production use is not certified.

capabilities.name: Deterministic index builder from discovery documents
capabilities.description: Local validator and index builder support a deterministic generated index.
limitations: Scaffolding only; downstream production use is not certified.

capabilities.name: Validation for malformed and duplicate entries
capabilities.description: Enforces strict bounded JSON parsing, duplicate-key and non-finite-number rejection, Draft 2020-12 schema constraints, HTTPS-only URIs, timezone-aware timestamps, resource count/field bounds and unique IDs.
limitations: Local validation/index construction only; no hosted endpoint, publisher authentication, authorization or runtime integration.

capabilities.name: Opt-in hosted discovery endpoint profile
capabilities.description: Hosted publisher authentication and endpoint interoperability are future work.
limitations: Not implemented; no interoperability or runtime claim.

explicit_non_capabilities: Copying authoritative schemas or manifests into a competing registry
